data.title: Add event compaction
data.body:
## Goal

Allow compacting old event logs to reduce file sizes while preserving final state.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket compact ID` replaces event log with snapshot
- [ ] Add `Snapshot { bug: Bug }` event type (or similar)
- [ ] Snapshot contains complete derived state at that point
- [ ] Original events can be archived before deletion
- [ ] `docket compact --all --older-than 30d` bulk compact old bugs
- [ ] Compaction is optional, never automatic
- [ ] Warn before destructive compaction

## Context

Old bugs with many events accumulate cruft. A bug with 50 status changes, updates, and notes creates a large JSONL file even though only the final state matters.

Compaction trades history for size. Should be explicit and optional since history has value.

Lower priority: file sizes are rarely a practical problem.
